title: CSA-FLAG UV Treatment -  TRiC controls transcription resumption after UV damage by regulating Cockayne syndrome protein A
projectDescription: SILAC comparison between CSA interactome before and after UV treatment.
sampleProcessingProtocol: CSA IP from SILAC labeled CS3BE cells before and after UV irradiation, SDS-PAGE, LC-MS/MS (Q Exactive): 1 lane CS3BE CSA-FLAG (K8/R10)/CS3BE FLAG (K0/R0) 2 lane CS3BE CSA-FLAG UV Treatment 20J/m2 (K8/R10) / CS3BE CSA-FLAG mock (K0/R0)
dataProcessingProtocol: LC-MS/MS, MaxQuant, SILAC multiplicity = 2 settings (K0/R0, K8R10), human Uniprot database
